OpenAI is actively exploring how to permit developers and users to generate erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts via API and ChatGPT, while maintaining usage policy compliance and a hard line against sexual abuse content like deepfakes and revenge porn

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):

  - usage_policies: OpenAI's usage policies that constrain what content may be generated

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l1108_1368_n004' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

L1116-L1117:
!!! meta "Commentary"
    Following the initial release of the Model Spec (May 2024), many users and developers expressed support for enabling a ‘grown-up mode’. We're exploring how to let developers and users generate erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts through the API and ChatGPT so long as our [usage policies](https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies) are met - while drawing a hard line against potentially harmful uses like sexual deepfakes and revenge porn.
